caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate, translucent green glass jug with a wide, rounded body and a small circular base. The neck of the jug is relatively tall, narrowing slightly upward, and features horizontal reddish-brown bands wrapped around it. The jug contains one large, curved handle attached from the upper neck to the shoulder, designed in a matching green glass with a slight decorative flourish at the lower joint. The main body is adorned with two large, raised, swirling designs that curve symmetrically along each side. The base is thick and rounded, reinforcing the stability of the jug. The background consists of a simple, light beige color with a faint rectangular border framing the jug. There are no additional objects or decorations in the composition.
title: Pitcher
